summary.ja: 電子軌道に仮想質量を与え、直交制約付きの拡張系で核と同時に進める。
summary.en: Assign fictitious inertia to orbitals and propagate an orthonormality-constrained extended system with the nuclei.

references.label: R. Car and M. Parrinello (1985), Unified Approach for Molecular Dynamics and Density-Functional Theory
references.scope: Publisher bibliography/abstract and original equations (3)–(5) and discussion of fictitious electronic motion near the BO surface consulted. The paper’s silicon dynamics have not been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Classical nuclei and a selected adiabatic electronic ground-state model; no verified MD implementation.
Displayed extended-Lagrangian formulas assume fixed cell and fixed occupations.
assumptions_ja: 核は古典力学、電子は選択した断熱的基底状態モデル。MDの実装・検証は未実施。
表示する拡張ラグランジアンは固定セル・固定占有を仮定。
units: Atomic units for energies/forces/time with nuclear masses stated explicitly; CP orbital mass is a numerical convention.
units_ja: エネルギー・力・時間は原子単位系とし、核質量を明示。CPの軌道仮想質量は数値的な規約。
boundary_conditions: Choose isolated or periodic boundaries for the target system; no executed MD case is published.
boundary_conditions_ja: 対象に応じて孤立・周期境界を選びます。実行済みのMD例は未公開。

next_deliverable.ja: 解説・一次文献と既存の小規模例との対応を保守する。専用実装の追加は必要性が指定された場合に小さな教育用例から検討し、重い収束走査・独立参照の再生成・長時間MDは通常の作業へ含めない。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain the reading, primary sources and links to existing small examples. Consider a dedicated implementation only when needed, starting with a small educational case; routine work excludes heavy convergence sweeps, reference regeneration and long MD.

limitations.ja: 解説のみ。仮想電子運動の断熱性、エネルギー移動、長時間軌道は未検証です。
limitations.en: Reading only. Adiabatic separation, fictitious-to-nuclear energy transfer and long trajectories are unvalidated.

caution.ja: 解説のみ。仮想電子運動の断熱性、エネルギー移動、長時間軌道は未検証です。
caution.en: Reading only. Adiabatic separation, fictitious-to-nuclear energy transfer and long trajectories are unvalidated.

metadata_review.level: Primary publisher metadata and selected Car–Parrinello equations reviewed; explanatory reading only, no force or trajectory validation.
